home.intro: Run a crewed base on Mars. No choice is free: the power that protects the crew today is the oxygen missing tomorrow.
home.solExplained: On Mars, a day has a name: sol. It lasts 40 minutes longer than ours.
home.howItWorksText: Each sol you get 10 power cells. 3 keep the base warm; you place the other 7. Life Support makes air tonight. The Greenhouse makes food two sols later. The Shield protects the crew tonight. Every number shows where it comes from: tap it.

briefing.title: Your mission
briefing.crew: Four astronauts live in a base in Jezero Crater, on Mars.
briefing.goal: Your mission lasts 7 sols. Then a ship takes everyone home.
briefing.air: Air: the crew breathes every sol. Mars air is not breathable, so you make it with power.
briefing.food: Food: the crew eats every sol. Plants grow slowly: plant today, eat later.
briefing.power: Power: 10 cells a sol, from weak Martian sunlight. Never enough for everything.

edge.title: Too far from the base
edge.text: A space suit has limited air and battery. Going farther would be reckless: turn back to the base.

sky.title: The Mars sky
sky.day: By day the Mars sky is yellow to orange, because of fine dust in the air. At sunset it turns blue near the Sun. From Mars, the Sun looks about two-thirds the size we see from Earth.
sky.photo: Real photo: sunset in Gale Crater, Mars, seen by the rover Curiosity on April 15, 2015 (sol 956). NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS/Texas A&M Univ., PIA19400.
sky.source: NASA Science: What do sunrises and sunsets look like on Mars?

sunWeek.title: The Sun this week
sunWeek.explain: A flare is a sudden flash of light on the Sun. A CME is a cloud of particles the Sun throws into space. The game's missions use real events like these.
sunWeek.compact: The Sun this week: {{flares}} flares, {{cmes}} particle clouds (NASA DONKI)

brief2.title: A real storm is coming
brief2.intro: This week is the real week of May 14–20, 2024. Every event comes from NASA records.
brief2.storm: Clouds from the Sun will reach Mars. On the last sol, the biggest radiation surge Curiosity had measured since it landed.
brief2.dose: Radiation dose limit: 2. Above it, the mission doctor sends the crew home.
brief2.sample: Bring 1 rock sample home. Every machine is open from sol 1.
brief2.crisis: When the storm comes fast, you have 10 seconds to choose.
